mechanics.claim: While the shield holds, Nautilus's basic attacks apply Pain of Wrath to the target and surrounding enemies.
mechanics.quote: his {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to apply ''Pain of Wrath'' to the target and enemies near them.

mechanics.claim: Pain of Wrath deals half its damage immediately and half after 1.25 seconds.
mechanics.quote: The target takes {{as|magic damage}} over time, half dealt immediately and the other half dealt after {{fd|1.25}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: Titan's Wrath resets Nautilus' basic attack timer when it triggers the empowered attack.
mechanics.quote: Titan's Wrath {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Nautilus' ''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: Reapplying Pain of Wrath to the same target adds a stack but does not restart the tick timer, and extra stacks deal no additional damage.
mechanics.quote: ''Pain of Wrath'' damage over time debuff gains another stack when reapplied to the target, but doesn't restart its tick timer. Additional stacks of ''Pain of Wrath'' expire when the original debuff does and do not deal any additional damage.

mechanics.claim: Pain of Wrath is applied if the empowered attack was active at the start of the windup, even if the shield expires during the windup.
mechanics.quote: ''Pain of Wrath'' will be applied by '''Nautilus's''' basic attack if he is affected by ''Titan's Wrath'' at the start of the {{tip|attack windup}}, even if ''Titan's Wrath'' expires during the windup.

mechanics.claim: Pain of Wrath is not applied if the attack is dodged or blocked, but is applied if it misses due to blind.
mechanics.quote: ''Pain of Wrath'' will not be applied if the basic attack is {{tip|dodged}} or {{tip|blocked}}, but will be applied if it is {{tip|blind|missed}}.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield blocks Pain of Wrath, but only a single application.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the ability (but only a single application).

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack does not apply Pain of Wrath to structures.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack does not apply ''Pain of Wrath'' to {{tip|structures}}.

mechanics.claim: The shield's cooldown starts on cast.
